Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Your offer excludes a price adjustment clause and sets out market index movements and their respective cost shares. Please provide the cost breakdown in XLSX format for negotiation of the individual elements; we do not accept index movements alone as justification for pricing unless they are reflected in your actual costs.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 36 months, 284400 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 4.79 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 90 days net, 36-month contract; option B: EUR 4.73 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 45 days net, 36-month contract; option C: EUR 4.70 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 36-month contract. Option A amounts to about EUR 1362276 over the term.
3. Basis: On 2026-09-10 you quoted us EUR 5.45 per unit for this part; your new quote is 11.0% above it. Beyond this part, we buy Sheet 1.4301 2 mm, 2B, cut to size from another supplier today, in a volume close to this bar's, and you have quoted it for us before. Once this agreement is signed, we will invite you to quote for it. Our demand forecast for this part is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We appreciate the prospect of quoting for the additional sheet volume and acknowledge the recent slight decrease in producer prices you cited.

Please understand that we cannot provide our internal cost breakdown in XLSX format, as our detailed cost structures are confidential. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. As another option, for a 36-month contract, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material risks; in exchange for this and the 14-day payment term, we can offer €5.44 per unit under a price of €5.44 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

We note your revised offer and your decision not to disclose the detailed cost breakdown. Any index-linked adjustment clause must be matched by a lower base price and a meaningful deadband, with adjustments starting only when index movements affect your actual costs.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 36 months, 284400 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 4.88 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 36-month contract. This amounts to about EUR 1387872 over the term.
3. Basis: Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. Our current offer features a price of €5.21 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.33 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
